name: Bowl with White Rim and Five Russet Markings against a Subtle Hare's Fur Glaze
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；12th-13th century；Northern black ware of Cizhou type:  light gray stoneware with dark brown glaze and with markings in overglaze iron-brown slip, the rim dressed with white slip under clear glaze, the base and unglazed lower portion with a brush-written inscription reading "Wei Han Han / Wei / Wei"
